steps.content: Your last blow lands, and the chaos before you begins to lose its shape, scattering into the dark. The sphere cracks and breaks free from its pedestal. A soft cyan glow seeps back into the air, casting its light over the wreckage.
Beneath the ruined stone platform, a slab grinds slowly aside, unveiling a passage leading down.
[Transition 1s]
Then the shadows inside the lanterns begin to move.

They draw themselves into thin, sinuous threads and slip through the tiny holes at the top of each lantern. Streaming between you and Chengxiao, they pour past like a silent river, cascading into the entrance at your feet and flooding the dark passage below.
The shackles thrum with increasing urgency. Lichen is inside, nearly close enough to touch.
You step forward, and instantly, fingers lock tight around your wrist, stopping you cold.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: Stop!

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: This is beyond us now. I'm sending you back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lichen is right down there. We can still make it!

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: The wicked being that will come next is beyond your ability to handle.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: That's not just some wicked being! It's something way worse than any of them.
You clench your jaw and claw at his fingers with your other hand, trying to peel them off. They don't move, not even a fraction.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: If we let her finish making that thing and it gets loose in Maria City, it's over. We have to stop her now—
The air thickens with chaotic whispers again, seeping in from every side and pressing closer around you both.
<color=#dg1f1f><i>Without rules... nothing holds its shape...
<color=#dg1f1f><i>Let... everything... return to the right path...
A subtle tremor runs along the rim of Chengxiao's mask. From somewhere deep inside, two points of dark red light flicker to life.
His breathing turns ragged and loud. Where his hand grips your wrist, a wave of Mania surges upward.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Let go. If you won't help, then I'll go myself.
You tear your arm away with a violent jerk, and this time his grip breaks. Stumbling from the force, you steady yourself and immediately dash toward the passage.
[White flash + sword swing SFX] Cut to CG
The hiss of a blade slicing through the air reaches you. Cold steel settles across your shoulder.
The mask moves aside, and the eyes beneath lock onto yours.

steps.speaker: Chengxiao
steps.content: This ends here.
